review_scope: Selected BNL public CB demonstration model at fixed delta0; exact real-arithmetic transverse map reduction plus empirical floating-point qualification.

findings.claim: Affine fixed-delta transverse map for eligible drifts, pure quadrupoles and MaxOrder1 bends
findings.detail: Same fourth-order split constants and actual NumIntSteps are composed. Bend edge methods0,1,2 remain linear at fixed delta; method3 and quad fringes must not be silently collapsed.

findings.claim: Guard boxes preserve skipped native element-end amplitude tests
findings.detail: Absolute prefix matrix bounds <=0.45 imply native transverse amplitudes<1. Delta fixed0 also meets native cutoff. Current calculations are floating with margin, not outward IEEE interval certificates.

findings.claim: Uncertain guard losses are native reruns
findings.detail: Full initial particle is rerun through native lattice; cost must be charged. Ordinary loss indices are remapped into native namespace before fallback rows replace them.

findings.claim: Removed linear CT increments remain finite over4096turns
findings.detail: Total removed contribution<1e60, starting from native-surviving element entrance norms<=1. Retained nonlinear CT finiteness and full IEEE proof remain separate.

unsupported_generic_inputs: MaxOrder0 element carrying nonzero higher coefficients is not handled by the frozen affine helper; selected BNL model uses MaxOrder1.
Arbitrary retained custom or M66 elements with ct-to-transverse coupling are unsupported even if ring.is_6d is false.
RF/radiation, changing delta, native apertures not represented by selected source, and full6D trajectory equivalence are outside the reviewed claim.
required_performance_boundary: Floating regrouping changes chaotic boundary trajectories. No speedup or all-point loss-equivalence theorem follows from element-level agreement; use frozen heldout qualification, retain failures, and charge native fallback and construction.
